stage.name: Icebound Valley
stage.description:
Blizzards, heaters, and frost-covered burdenbeasts. Rhodes Island, a delegation, and the snowy valleys of Kjerag. Those who couldn't get their fill of excitement on the frozen lake have gathered in a secluded spot for a fierce showdown. Unfortunately, they've disturbed the peaceful slumber of the burdenbeasts.
<Condition> DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Emergency Heater> Makes surrounding Operators immune to the Frigid environmental effect.

delegation_recruit.name: Delegation Recruit
delegation_recruit.flavourText: Soldier recruited into the delegation, employing the standard orthodox tactics. They are enjoying the peaceful lull.

delegation_veteran.name: Delegation Veteran
delegation_veteran.flavourText: Soldier whose fate is entwined with the delegation, employing hardened and ruthless tactics. They are on guard against potential escalation.

clockwork_warrior.name: Clockwork Warrior
clockwork_warrior.flavourText: Patrol machine developed for the local environment. Moves faster if it is wound up a few times before battle. High firepower.
abilities: Movement speed is reduced in Emergency Heater range.

clockwork_patroller.name: Clockwork Patroller
clockwork_patroller.flavourText: Patrol machine developed for the local environment. Moves faster if it is wound up a few times before battle. Low firepower.
abilities: Movement speed is reduced in Emergency Heater range.

delegation_assault_recruit.name: Delegation Assault Recruit
delegation_assault_recruit.flavourText: New recruits on a special mission, firing warning shots with non-lethal weapons to avoid unnecessary loss of life. Having never seen war with their own eyes, they carry out their mission with expectations of peace.
abilities: Attacks in <Frigid> areas deal Arts damage; attacks in Emergency Heater range deal Physical damage.

delegation_caster_commander.name: Delegation Caster Commander
delegation_caster_commander.flavourText: Ferocious Arts attackers of the delegation, casting with resonant harmony, but still ordered to take it easy.
abilities: Attacks in <Frigid> areas deal splash damage in a cross; trait is inactive in Emergency Heater range.

delegation_caster.name: Delegation Caster
delegation_caster.flavourText: Elite Arts attackers of the delegation, casting with perfect coordination, but still asked to take it easy.
abilities: Attacks in <Frigid> areas deal splash damage in a cross; trait is inactive in Emergency Heater range.

delegation_centurion_champion.name: Delegation Centurion Champion
delegation_centurion_champion.flavourText: If defeating heater defenders has become the focus of the delegation's training, then it is no surprise that a champion would eventually emerge.
abilities: Invisible
Prioritizes targets to the right of a Emergency Heater

delegation_assault_veteran.name: Delegation Assault Veteran
delegation_assault_veteran.flavourText: Veteran on a special mission, firing warning shots with non-lethal weapons to avoid unnecessary loss of life. Having seen death with their own eyes, they respond to orders with the instinctive reactions of war.
abilities: Attacks in <Frigid> areas deal Arts damage; attacks in Emergency Heater range deal Physical damage.

delegation_centurion.name: Delegation Centurion
delegation_centurion.flavourText: Centurions are normally tasked with assaulting a fortified position. In the delegation, their main task is to defeat the defenders of the heaters.
abilities: Invisible
Prioritizes targets to the right of a Emergency Heater

boom_canister.name: 'Boom Canister'
boom_canister.flavourText: After many broken and exploded cans, people came to the realization that this weapon needed someone with a death wish, making trench warfare even more painful.
abilities: On death, deals Arts damage to all nearby units, inflicting Cold and disabling Emergency Heaters.

catapult.name: 'Catapult'
catapult.flavourText: Expert grenadiers of the delegation, able to throw shells as heavy as a hundred kilos. The rest of the delegation knows better than to challenge them to a snowball fight.
abilities: Throws a massive snowball, dealing splash damage in a cross
Can only use melee attacks once snowball is thrown

delegation_shieldbearer.name: Delegation Shieldbearer
delegation_shieldbearer.flavourText: Determined defenders of the delegation, their shields one with the frozen crystals, forming a wall on the snow that few can penetrate.
abilities: DEF and RES gradually increase in <Frigid> areas, and gradually decrease in Emergency Heater range.

delegation_shieldbearer_captain.name: Delegation Shieldbearer Captain
delegation_shieldbearer_captain.flavourText: Outstanding defenders of the delegation, their form one with heaven and earth, forming an unbreakable wall in the snow.
abilities: DEF and RES gradually increase in <Frigid> areas, and gradually decrease in Emergency Heater range.

mortar.name: 'Mortar'
mortar.flavourText: Elite grenadiers of the delegation, able to throw shells with the same power as city artillery. No one in the delegation is foolish enough to challenge them, so they roam the snow with their carefully crafted balls, waiting for a challenger foolish enough to fall into their trap.
abilities: Throws a massive snowball, dealing splash damage in a cross
Can only use melee attacks once snowball is thrown

frozen_mountain_burdenbeast.name: Frozen Mountain Burdenbeast
frozen_mountain_burdenbeast.flavourText: Mountain burdenbeast buried by a sudden avalanche. Its thick layer of fat will help it survive the worst of it until rescue arrives.
abilities: Remains on standby in <Frigid> areas for a while without attacking.
Immediately revived if its plate is in Emergency Heater range

jet_canister.name: 'Jet Canister'
jet_canister.flavourText: This weapon was developed for close-range assault in response to the painful experience of trench warfare, but how many would be willing to carry a such a heavy and fragile can on their backs?
abilities: On death, deals Arts damage to all nearby units, inflicting Cold and disabling Emergency Heaters.

slumbering_mountain_burdenbeast.name: Slumbering Mountain Burdenbeast
slumbering_mountain_burdenbeast.flavourText: Mountain burdenbeast buried by familiar snowfall. It will rest well in its habitual hibernation until it senses the spring breeze.
abilities: Remains on standby in <Frigid> areas for a while without attacking.
Immediately revived if its plate is in Emergency Heater range
